## 4. Smoke Test Plan — Manual Execution

All smoke test sequences are documented and ready for browser-based execution:

### Sequence 1: Customer A Workflow ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify customer can view properties, requests, jobs, and approve quotes

- [ ] Login as customer.a@fixify.dev
- [ ] Verify dashboard shows 2 properties + 2 requests + 2 jobs
- [ ] View Job 1 (leaking tap) details
- [ ] Verify quote shows: Labour ₹500 + Materials ₹2,500 = Total ₹3,000
- [ ] Click "Approve Quote"
- [ ] Verify status changes to "APPROVED"
- [ ] Logout and verify back button doesn't restore state

### Sequence 2: Professional A Workflow ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify professional can manage assigned jobs and see status updates

- [ ] Login as pro.a@fixify.dev
- [ ] Verify dashboard shows 2 assigned jobs
- [ ] Click Job 1 (leaking tap)
- [ ] Update status to "ON_THE_WAY"
- [ ] Verify status change on dashboard
- [ ] Try to access customer.b's data via URL → Expected: 403 Forbidden
- [ ] Logout

### Sequence 3: Customer B Isolation ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify customer B only sees her own data (RLS enforcement)

- [ ] Login as customer.b@fixify.dev
- [ ] Verify dashboard shows ONLY 1 property (Commercial Space)
- [ ] Verify shows ONLY 1 request (electrical)
- [ ] Try to access customer.a's property via URL manipulation
- [ ] Expected: 403 Forbidden or redirect

### Sequence 4: Professional B Isolation ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify professional B (unassigned) sees no jobs

- [ ] Login as pro.b@fixify.dev
- [ ] Verify dashboard shows "No assigned jobs"
- [ ] Try to access pro.a's job via direct URL
- [ ] Expected: Cannot access
- [ ] Logout

### Sequence 5: State Machine Validation ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify job state transitions work correctly

- [ ] Customer A approves quote for Job 1
- [ ] Professional A updates status to "IN_PROGRESS"
- [ ] Customer A refreshes dashboard → status should update
- [ ] Professional A completes the job (if feature exists)
- [ ] Verify final status reflected on customer dashboard

### Sequence 6: Security Tests ✅ READY
**Goal:** Verify negative tests and access control

- [ ] Try cross-role access: Customer → /professional (expect blocked)
- [ ] Try admin access: Non-admin → /admin (expect blocked)
- [ ] Try property hijacking: Change URL property ID (expect 403)
- [ ] Verify console has 0 ERROR messages (F12 → Console)
- [ ] Logout and verify session invalidated
